title: Order, Undone
summary: A study in loss of control: a perfectly ordered stage slowly fails, breaks open at the climax, and ends in silence.
understood: Arc: Order → Tremor → Fracture → Collapse → Silence.
Matched cues (demo rules): order, collapse, silence.
Proposed constraint: End in complete silence.
Proposed constraint: Open in perfect order.

phases.name: Order
phases.note: A perfect grid, held still. Cold light, a single slow pulse.

phases.name: Tremor
phases.note: The grid begins to breathe out of time.

phases.name: Fracture
phases.note: Alignment fails; shards separate, the pulse doubles.

strategy: Earn the climax through contrast: keep restraint before the release so the peak lands as a change, not more of the same.
